name: Sitemap Manager
author: michaelgrover

sections.description:
Sitemap Manager gives you full control over your WordPress XML sitemap. Easily exclude thank-you pages, landing pages, or other URLs you don’t want indexed.

It works with Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO, and even the native WordPress sitemap.

Perfect for advanced SEO, content strategy, and hybrid sites.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sitemap-manager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Tools → Sitemap Manager to manage your sitemap.
sections.faq:
Can I use this plugin with Yoast or other SEO plugins?

Yes. Sitemap Manager works seamlessly with popular SEO plugins like Yoast, Rank Math, and AIOSEO. It also supports the native WordPress sitemap if no SEO plugin is installed.

What does Sitemap Manager do?

Sitemap Manager gives you direct control over your sitemap contents. You can exclude specific posts or pages (such as thank-you pages or other campaign pages) that you don’t want search engines to see.

Can I add pages or URLs that aren’t part of my WordPress site?

With Sitemap Manager Pro you can manually add any valid URL on your domain, including static HTML pages or dynamic (or static) PHP pages, and Sitemap Manager will include them in a dedicated sitemap.

How do I exclude a post or page from the sitemap?

Go to Tools → Sitemap Manager → Sitemap, check the box next to any post or page you want to exclude, and click Save Changes.

I switched SEO plugins. Will this still work?

Yes. Sitemap Manager automatically detects your active SEO plugin and adjusts its behavior accordingly. Your exclusions and custom URLs are preserved.

Is there a limit to the number of URLs I can manage?

Sitemap Manager does not limit the number of URLs you can manage, no matter how many URLs your xml sitemap contains.

Where can I learn more about the Pro version?

Visit Sitemap Manager Pro for details.
